scope: East Ramapo Central School District SLP RFP-ER-5-27; public procurement evidence and proposed response preparation, not an executed bid.
readiness_note: Confirmed means the requirement is supported by the reviewed source; it does not mean our company satisfies it. Formation/registration, qualified named clinicians, coverage, substantiated representations and authorized signatures remain readiness gates.

procurement.deadline_note: Local time in RFP; these October dates are EDT. Recheck all subsequent addenda before acting.

question_contact.name: Michelle Rivera
question_contact.channel: Written RFP questions only; answers by addendum on BidNet and district site. Service coordinator contact withheld until award.

procurement.submission_channel: Electronic submission through Empire State Purchasing Group / BidNet Direct, https://www.bidnetdirect.com/new-york. RFP describes a free Limited registration option. No account created or logged into in this research.
procurement.route_precedence: Use the solicitation-specific electronic instructions, not the district index generic mail/drop-off paragraph.
portal_unknowns: Authenticated event upload fields, file-size limits and acknowledgment checkboxes not inspected.
Free-registration and account setup steps not performed.
Only the district public index was checked for addenda; final response must also inspect the authorized BidNet event.
procurement.award_method: Best value; price plus qualifications, responsiveness and responsibility. Lowest fee is not determinative. Board approval and formal contract required; no fixed award date published.
procurement.renewal_ambiguity: RFP p.5 refers to a Physical Therapist, says four (3) additional years and a four-year total. Obtain correction; do not model renewal as assured.
procurement.termination: Either party may terminate with 30 days written notice. District owes unpaid services performed and authorized costs incurred; no termination profit guarantee stated.
procurement.volume: Assignments fluctuate from individual part-time sessions to full-time leave replacement; billed hours depend on the approved assignment schedule. No guaranteed caseload, FTE or weekly revenue.
procurement.payment: District approves service performance before payment authorization. No net payment interval or invoice-payment deadline located. The 30-calendar-day rule concerns invoice plus attendance submission after service.
procurement.document_completeness_note: RFP p.3 bars documents after bid opening while p.5 reserves district discretion to request additional information. Plan a complete bid; do not rely on a later cure.

form_checklist.requirement: Letterhead, authorized-contact details and authority/perjury certification.
Both acknowledgment sections, contact details and dates; attach COI with bid. Broker confirmation does not replace the COI.
Signature, printed name/title and date on supplied form.
Company name, signature/title, sworn date and notary stamp/seal; submit notarized copy.
Bidder/business contact fields, bid date, signature and title. If certification cannot truthfully be made, the RFP provides for a detailed signed explanation; district determines acceptability.
Signed and notarized form with proposal; owner/legal review must understand defense and surviving indemnity obligation.

Initial representation covers the bidder/entity and its employees/contractors; substantiate it before signing/submitting. No separate signature field is printed. Retain the clause in the complete response. Monthly employee/subcontractor checks and event notices are separate operating obligations.

eligibility.clinician: Required SLP licenses/certifications, state-required education and experience with children with IEPs. Individual proposed clinician resumes/references at submission. Additional candidates may be considered after contract establishment.
eligibility.organization: No record of unsatisfactory performance is an express minimum provider requirement. Administrative/fiscal capability, adequate records and audit trail, sufficient financial resources or ability to obtain them, integrity and delivery capacity are also required.
not_found: No numeric minimum company age in the reviewed RFP/addendum.
No specified count or format for clinician references.
No required ASHA CCC, bilingual ability or minimum years of clinician experience expressly stated in this RFP. Separate applicable law and assignment requirements still govern.
No named IEP, attendance or billing system in the RFP/addendum.
eligibility.new_entity_limit: Absence of a firm-age threshold does not waive responsibility criteria or the no-unsatisfactory-performance gate. Disclose the new company and truthful relevant full performance history; distinguish individual/predecessor experience from company history. Obtain district clarification on acceptable new-entity evidence. Selected positive references alone do not substantiate the negative performance-history representation.

price_schedule_note: No district-issued price worksheet, fixed billing increment or prescribed rate-line list appears in the reviewed 22-page RFP or Addendum 1. The following is our proposed response-rate-card structure, not district-confirmed payable units or additional mandatory bid lines. Avoid double charging included work.

questions_draft.question: What fee units should proposers use, and how should individual/group therapy, evaluations, CSE meetings, documentation, inter-school travel and cancellations be priced? Can you provide a nonbinding range of initial assignments and expected approved weekly hours?
questions_draft.reason: Critical to a defensible rate and minimum viable assignment.

questions_draft.question: For a newly formed agency proposing experienced named clinicians, what company-registration and full performance-history evidence will satisfy responsibility criteria, including the p.7 no-record-of-unsatisfactory-performance requirement? How many clinician references are required?
questions_draft.reason: Distinguishes individual experience from company history and tests the express negative-history gate; selected positive references do not establish it.

questions_draft.question: Which of pages 5, 7-9 controls the final insurance schedule, including auto/excess, insurer standards, endorsements and cancellation wording? Please confirm exact evidence required with the bid versus at contract execution.
questions_draft.reason: COI and p.10 signatures are already stated bid requirements; clarification addresses overlapping schedules.

questions_draft.question: What is the payment interval after an accepted invoice, who approves attendance/service completion, and how are invoice rejections corrected? Is an assignment or purchase order required before service?
questions_draft.reason: Thirty days in p.6 is submission deadline, not payment promise.

questions_draft.question: Please correct p.5 renewal wording (Physical Therapist, four (3) additional years, four-year total) and state anticipated award and earliest service date.
questions_draft.reason: Avoids an invented award date or renewal forecast.

questions_draft.question: Which systems/templates must providers use for IEP access, weekly logs, attendance and invoices, and what data agreement, role approval, training and incident notification terms apply?
questions_draft.reason: No named platform or integration/API entitlement is established by this RFP.

questions_draft.question: What district onboarding/clearance evidence and review lead time apply to each named provider, substitutes and post-award additions? What notice/approval is required when a provider is unavailable?
questions_draft.reason: RFP permits later candidate consideration, not automatic replacement.

questions_draft.question: If an agency uses independent-contractor clinicians or a subcontracted clinical entity, how should written consent under p.11 be requested and documented?
questions_draft.reason: Needed only if considering that structure; proposed initial W-2 approach does not assume permission.

procedural_checklist.detail: User confirms a new company, no confirmed therapists and no insurance: not bid-ready. Establish the entity, actual named clinician capacity, credentials, coverage and capital; substantiate full performance history and entity/personnel eligibility before any certification.
Map each RFP item to a real attachment; draft narrative and proposed rate units.
Owner-authorized question submission, if pursued, goes only to named purchasing contact; no outreach has occurred.
Broker/bidder certification; COI; three notarized forms; other signed forms and W-9. Only authorized humans certify facts.
Recheck addenda, actual provider readiness, company/insurance eligibility, rate margin and cash runway. No-bid if material gates cannot be satisfied.
If owner elects to bid, review portal format with authorized account, validate all uploads and receipts; this target is earlier than official deadline.
Complete authorized submission before cutoff; a local PDF or saved draft is not proof of receipt.
Executed agreement, insurance acceptance, provider approval, district onboarding/data access, funded assignments, approved schedule and payroll setup.
Weekly service logs; invoice+attendance within30 days; monthly exclusions;3-day exclusion notices; credential/insurance monitoring and cash reconciliation.
